translation_notes: initNs-only case (no initBindings anywhere in this function): `initNs={"dcterms": 'http://purl.org/dc/terms/'}` is a static IRI known at transpile time, so it becomes a module-level `@prefix dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/> .`, and the query's prologue is inherited from it, per the stratum's correspondence rule. No interpolation is needed.

`prepareQuery(TEXT, initNs=...)` collapses into an `s{ }` island written literally at the point of use, still assigned to `Q_LOCAL_DCTERMS_LICENSE` -- an island is an expression, so binding it to a name and later calling `Q_LOCAL_DCTERMS_LICENSE(parsed_graph)` (`call suffix (g)`) behaves exactly like writing `s{ ... }(parsed_graph)` inline; verified with the transpiler.

`log_query(Q_LOCAL_DCTERMS_LICENSE)` (a project helper that only logs `str(query)`, see dataset_preparation_shim.py) is kept as-is: it receives the `s{ }` Query object itself, not a call result, on both sides.
